name: After § 35 – 1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on media freedom and rule of law in the Czech Republic: threats to the independence of public broadcasters
part_text: 35a. Recalls that the EU has no general competence to assess the overall state of the rule of law in a sovereign Member State; recalls that the EMFA was established on the basis of Article 114 TFEU, concerning the approximation of national laws for the establishment and functioning of the internal market, and nothing more; recalls that a sovereign Member State is free to decide how to fund a public broadcaster; recalls that a sovereign Member State is free to decide on increases or cuts in its national budget, including those concerning a public broadcaster; recalls that the Commission rightly stated on 11 November 2026 that EU legislation does not prescribe how public service media should be funded; recognises that there is no reason for concern about media freedom and the rule of law in the Czech Republic, and no threat to the independence of public broadcasters;
